title: April 6, 2026: Top 5 AI News For Today!
description:
Top 5 AI news for today covering the biggest moves in artificial intelligence—from pricing changes to self-improving models.

Anthropic is making major shifts—moving to pay-as-you-go pricing for Claude tools and acquiring biotech startup Coefficient Bio for $400M to push into AI-driven drug discovery.

We also break down how AI actually learns (hint: it’s not just the model), the growing debate between MCP vs Skills in AI agents, and how self-distillation is helping models improve by learning from their own outputs.

If you’re building, learning, or investing in AI—this is what matters right now.
